english.title: Permit destruction falsification etc of information or documents relating to an information or assessment notice
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE OFFENCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 148(2)(b) of the Data Protection Act 2018.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being a person who had been given an information notice / assessment notice by the Commissioner
permitted the destruction / disposal / concealment / blocking / falsification of
all or part of the information / document / equipment / material
with the intention of preventing the Commissioner from viewing / being provided with or directed to
all or part of the information / document / equipment / material

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
Outline offence wording archived as duplicate of CJS DN18019 H19364(i) Prosecution only by the Commissioner or by or with the consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions.
(ii) It is a defence for a person charged with an offence under section 148(3) to prove that the destruction, disposal, concealment, blocking or falsification would have occurred in the absence of the person being given the notice.
(iii) Where this offence has been committed by a body corporate, and it is proved to have been committed with the consent or connivance of or to be attributable to neglect on the part of a director, manager, secretary or similar officer of the body corporate, or a person who was purporting to act in such a capacity, the director, manager, secretary, as well as the body corporate is guilty of the offence and proceedings can also be taken against them.

other.penalty:
Either Way -
Summary: A fine.
Indictment: A fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
